retained_capacity_caveat: Original construction retained bytes are unchanged. Genuine moves retain source capacity, while old copy-like moves compact it: pruned short-key final snapshots retain approximately 13.3–13.5% more requested heap. Do not generalize unchanged construction memory to final publication.
